which_sequence_reproduces: A on 'Manage AI models…' reproduces it every time (3 of 3): the screen opens with the Filters panel open and the ring on 'Open source only (recommended)', one A away from changing the licence filter. 'Browse models…' never did (0 of 13), whatever way the screen was last closed (B, Done, B with the panel open) and after two plugin reloads. Both buttons open the same 'AI models' dialog.
other_observations: The header differs by route: Browse showed 'Installed 2 · 4.3 GB · Live catalog · Offline sizes'; Manage showed 'Installed 2 · 4.0 GB · Live catalog · Live sizes'.
B does two different things with the panel open: ring on the Filters button -> B closes the whole screen; ring inside the panel -> B folds only the panel and puts the ring back on the Filters button.
Walking Up out of the open panel folds it shut by itself (screenshot plan70-HUB-EDGE-01-panel-folded-after-up.png).

A on the Filters button (Browse route): the ring stayed on the Filters button for 6 s (read every 0.1 s). One sweep's first recorded stop was 'Open source only' right after opening the panel; that sweep also reported one press retried because the port was busy, so a Down probably landed before its first read. Recorded, not counted as the bug.
filters_changed: none (still '2 on: Also try open-weight models, Essentials only' after every close)
verdict: MEASURED (no pass/fail row). Reproduces 3 of 3 through 'Manage AI models…'; never through 'Browse models…'.
